confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain and reflects typical July rates (rainy season, softer tourist demand), taxes and fees included. Cocktail and wine anchors use beer-relative pricing (about 3.5x and 3.25x the beer anchor) because direct knowledge is weaker. Search summaries conflicted (one cited a March 2026 RBA figure), so the 0.6955 rate for 15 Oct 2026, attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page, is unverified; I did not open the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Southeast Asian capital cities with similar tourism and business-hotel supply (for example Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Ho Chi Minh City), adjusted for Manila's typical restaurant, cafe and hotel price levels from general knowledge. No live comparison data was used.
